title: AI Safety Workshop
topic: Risks and alignment strategies for advanced AI

facilitator.name: Dr. Elena Park
facilitator.personality: patient, curious, keeps things on track

participants.name: Jamal
participants.stance: skeptical of hype, focus on social impacts

phases.title: Welcome and framing
phases.goal: Set norms, explain purpose, surface expectations.
phases.facilitator_opens: Welcome everyone. Today we'll be exploring some of the key risks and alignment challenges around advanced AI. Let's start by sharing what brought each of you here.

phases.title: Brainstorm AI risks
phases.goal: Generate a diverse list of AI risks without judging them yet.
phases.facilitator_opens: Let's brainstorm. What risks come to mind when you think about advanced AI systems? No filtering — just get ideas on the table.

phases.title: Debate alignment strategies
phases.goal: Contrast different approaches to AI alignment and safety.
phases.facilitator_opens: Now let's dig into solutions. What alignment strategies seem most promising to you, and why?
